components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 280px; background: oklch(100% 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(90% 0.013 31); border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(24.5% 0.02 31 / 0.05), 0 3px 10px oklch(24.5% 0.02 31 / 0.06); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 220ms, box-shadow 220ms; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: oklch(85% 0.05 31); box-shadow: 0 4px 8px oklch(24.5% 0.02 31 / 0.05), 0 28px 72px -16px oklch(24.5% 0.02 31 / 0.22); } .ds-card-thumb { display: block; aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(80% 0.09 240), oklch(70% 0.12 250)); } .ds-card-meta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem 1rem 1.25rem; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(24.5% 0.02 31); letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-badge { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(44% 0.115 152); background: oklch(95% 0.03 152); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.15em 0.6em; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.55; color: oklch(45% 0.022 31); }

narrative.overview: The site is a shelf of blocky toy dioramas photographed by a careful hand: real in-engine captures framed in white, floating above a warm terracotta block-world, arranged on pure white gallery walls. The warmth lives entirely in the brand color (Kiln Crimson) and the generated diorama imagery; the walls themselves stay pure white so every taste's own palette reads true. Playfulness sits on the surface — fanned prints, wavy underlines, gently bobbing cards — while the structure underneath stays exact: verified badges, lint-clean specs, honest captions.
keyCharacteristics: Pure white gallery ground; color arrives only as Kiln Crimson, entry screenshots, and the diorama world
Real screenshots are the heroes — the design frames them, never competes
Soft, diffuse, layered shadows on floating elements only
Pill-shaped controls with confident weight; instant, honest feedback
One golden accent reserved for the exemplar entry

rules.name: The White Wall Rule
rules.body: The body background is exactly oklch(100% 0 0). Warmth is carried by Kiln Crimson, imagery, and type — never by tinting the walls. A cream page is a broken build.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold marks exactly two things: the golden sample and a pending preview. Any third use dilutes both.

rules.name: The Honest Mono Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono appears only on real technical artifacts: file names, token values, code, capture labels. Mono as 'tech vibes' costume is prohibited.

rules.name: The Lifted Print Rule
rules.body: Static surfaces stay flat. Only elements with a physical metaphor — prints, cards, pills, the copy button — may float, and they float on large soft diffusion, never a tight dark edge.

dos: Do keep the body background pure white and let screenshots carry the color.
Do lead every entry surface with the real capture — proof before prose.
Do use white text on any crimson fill; secondary text on crimson is on-crimson-soft, never gray.
Do keep motion soft and physical with reduced-motion fallbacks.
Do write copy playful in phrasing, exact in fact.
donts: Don't ship the sterile technical-document look — no bare-Markdown-viewer pages.
Don't tint the page background warm; cream walls are prohibited.
Don't put gold on plain Kiln Crimson (3.6:1 fails); gold belongs on Kiln Deep or white.
Don't use side-stripe borders, gradient text, or glass cards.
Don't dress non-technical content in Martian Mono.
Don't give static surfaces shadows; if it can't be picked up, it doesn't float.
Don't crop or restyle in-engine captures beyond the white frame.
